speaker: freelancer
text: Please give me a moment to check the files, Tessa, and I’ll resend them shortly. I’m sorry about the issue, and thank you for your patience and for bringing it to my attention.

speaker: client
text: Before we proceed, could you confirm whether the fixed cost covers the brand colours and fonts that will be set out for us? The truck’s illuminated lettering reads ‘Copper Crust Truck’ and uses Clab, but we do not necessarily want or need that same typeface for the logo. We hope to hire you; we simply wanted to clarify which colour and font guidelines would be produced first.

speaker: freelancer
text: Everything required for a consistent brand identity going forward will be covered: the fixed cost includes both the brand colors and the font.

speaker: freelancer
text: I’m available to begin immediately. Could you let me know whether you have a particular completion timeline in mind for the project?

speaker: client
text: With both of us busy with our day-to-day work while trying to launch this start-up, there is no immediate rush. Would completion within the next 5 weeks work for you? We still need to complete your hire contract before proceeding, so please bear with us.

speaker: freelancer
text: That timing is perfect for me. I’m now looking forward to receiving the contract.

speaker: freelancer
text: I appreciate the offer and will return with the initial concepts.

speaker: client
text: Before any concept work begins, we’ll send over some examples we like, although we’re also interested in your own ideas. Please hold off on starting the concepts until we’ve got back to you. Thanks, Tessa

speaker: freelancer
text: When you’re ready, please send across any concepts or references you like. I’ll review them carefully before beginning the creative process, then combine your inspirations with my own ideas to develop something unique and memorable for your brand. That sounds like a great approach, and I’m looking forward to seeing what inspires you.

speaker: freelancer
text: I’m looking forward to receiving the inspiration concepts, Tessa.

speaker: client
text: It’s been one of those weeks, so please bear with us! We haven’t forgotten.

speaker: freelancer
text: I’ll be ready when it arrives.

speaker: client
text:
Attached is an AI-generated draft logo that we made while simply experimenting with chat gpt. It is only inspiration: we still want fresh, original ideas, which is why we posted the proposal. We do, however, like its colours because they fit the look and feel of the Copper Crust truck.

The company is called ‘Copper Crust’, so the logo must not contain the word ‘truck’. The mobile catering truck is only one part of the wider business. Copper Crust will operate that truck, sell food online and may also supply other caterers or kitchens. That broader scope is why the company name excludes ‘truck’, while the existing strapline remains unchanged. Would you be happy to discuss any of this before accepting the offer?

speaker: client
text: As explained above, the truck shown here represents only one part of the wider business.

speaker: freelancer
text: To reflect your vision, I’ll develop several concepts and add a creative touch so that each design feels visually appealing and unique.

speaker: freelancer
text: My usual approach is to share the initial drafts before accepting the offer. That lets clients review the proposed direction first and feel completely comfortable before moving forward.

speaker: freelancer
text: Whichever timing makes you most comfortable will work for me. I can present the initial concepts and accept the offer afterward, or I can accept it immediately if that is what you would prefer.

speaker: client
text: Let’s use your suggested approach and review the initial drafts before the offer is accepted. Thank you.

speaker: freelancer
text: Thank you.

speaker: freelancer
text: The initial drafts are ready for you to review, Tessa, and I’d love to hear your thoughts. Please tell me about any revisions, refinements, iterations or other changes you would like; I’m happy to keep working with you until the result fully matches your vision.

speaker: client
text: After looking through the drafts, Julian (my spouse, who leads the kitchen and founded the venture!!) and I added our consolidated feedback to the attached powerpoint. Thank you so much for the concepts. Hopefully our comments make sense, but please ask if anything is unclear. All best, Tessa

speaker: freelancer
text: Thanks for sending the feedback, Tessa. I’ll review your comments and return with the updated designs.

speaker: freelancer
text: The designs are ready for review, Tessa; please take a look and share your feedback.

speaker: client
text:
The graduated orange colour and the lines beside the strapline both work well for us. Of the concepts, we like the 2nd and 6th one; the typeface in the 5th one feels too plain. Our concern with the flame in the 6th one is that someone unfamiliar with our name may not recognise it as an ‘O’, although we do like the treatment.

Could you test every suggested solution: enclosing the flame within an ‘O’, shaping the flame more clearly like an ‘O’, and superimposing it onto an ‘O’?

For logo 6, please also show us how a slightly larger ‘dough’ would look. The strapline could stand out either by outlining every letter with a thin black pencil line or by slightly brightening the orange tones in its lettering. We like the character of the font used for copper crust, particularly the G. We wondered whether a couple of the other letters could gain a little character too, but it would be better to handle revisions one stage at a time because the current font may already be suitable. Thank you—we’re moving in the right direction.

speaker: freelancer
text: I’ll go through the feedback carefully and will come back to you if anything needs clarification. Thank you.

speaker: freelancer
text: Your feedback has now been incorporated, Tessa. Please review the updated designs and share your thoughts.

speaker: client
text: Work has completely swamped us, but thank you for sending these. We’ll get back to you over the weekend.

speaker: freelancer
text: Sure, take your time!
